liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (3 reviews): The transition from Help On The Way into Slipknot and Franklin's Tower was excellent; The Help On The Way to Slipknot transition is highlighted as a real gem [12][13][16]
- **Jack A Roe** (1 review): The listener particularly enjoyed The Same Thing and Jack A Roe in the first set [21]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Major tempo issues bogged down the performance of All Along The Watchtower [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1994-07-21.112808.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 23 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd94-07-21.sbd.ladner.12322.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 3.5/5 by 8 [2]. Said about its sound: This specific copy of the recording is considered slightly better than other versions [12]
- **gd1994-07-21.sbd.braverman.9406.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 2.33/5 by 3 [3]
- **gd1994-07-21.aud.unknown.larson.31804.shnf**: audience recording; 21 songs; 183 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1994-07-21.akg460.flaschner.davis.91155.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 182 min [9]. Said about its sound: Eight decibels were added to the patch source to better match audio levels [9]

## Around the show

- Helicopter hovered over the venue while the band began playing Watchtower [11]
- Jerry exclaimed the place was perfect, which Bobby repeated to the audience [18]
- Farmers near the venue complained about fans grilling in their front yards [19]
- The listener received their diploma on the stage at Deer Creek two weeks prior [20]
- The listener arrived in Noblesville during an intense rain storm the night before [21]
- The second set was rated higher than the first set by the listener [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1994-07-21.112808.bk.schmit.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Alan Schmit; source: Source: (ORTF/110^/DFC/FOB) B&K 4011s > Neumann BS48i-2 > Modified Sony TCD-D10 Pro > DAT(m); [1]. Also: Set IIe is tracked seamlessly, allowing for flexible burning of the files [1]
- **gd94-07-21.sbd.ladner.12322.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard - Shntool fix (by Chris Ladner) of previous [2]. Also: The show demonstrates the band adapting to a new digital era with crisp sounds [13]
- **gd1994-07-21.sbd.braverman.9406.shnf**: transferred by Rob Harrison and Peter Braverman; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Minor cuts exist at the start of Touch of Grey and Music Never Stopped; A tape flip occurred a few seconds into the song Space [3]
- **gd1994-07-21.aud.unknown.larson.31804.shnf**: transferred by Chris Larson; source: A:D(48kHz) no mic info [4]. Also: The listener has owned a board recording of this show since the summer of 1995 [22]
- **gd1994-07-21.akg460.flaschner.davis.91155.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Chris Davis; source: (OTS) AKG 460b/ck61 -> custom pre-amp -> D-7 [9]. Also: Dave's source cut at 04:03, requiring a splice from another source [9]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-21 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-21-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [24]
- Poster by Robbi Cohn: [1994-07-21 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-21-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [25]
- Poster by Michael Mullen Grateful Dead: [1994-07-20 Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1994-07-20-deer-creek-music-center-noblesville-in-usa/) [26]
- Poster by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1994-07-21 Thu Deer Creek Music Center, Noblesville, IN](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1395964801105/grateful-dead-1994-07-21-thu-deer-creek) [27]
